examples.title: Create a FieldMerge node
examples.code:
# Create the node and keep a reference to it.
fieldMerge = nuke.createNode("FieldMerge")

provenance.editorial_note: Node class is present in the locked scanner dataset; Foundry toolbar source is used where the class is exposed in the standard toolbar.

examples.code:
# Choose the node's processing operation.
fieldMerge = nuke.createNode("FieldMerge")
fieldMerge["operation"].setValue("subtract\tSubtract")
examples.title: Set Operation
Inspect the node's public knobs
examples.code:
# List the knob names exposed by this node in your Nuke version.
fieldMerge = nuke.createNode("FieldMerge")
print(fieldMerge.knobs().keys())

provenance.editorial_note: Useful when node controls vary by Nuke version or the node is specialized.
